newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on U.S., bonds, Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on U.S., bonds, Ericsson.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Friday, depressed by lower prices on Wall Street, sharply higher bond yields and a fall in telecoms group Ericsson.
The exchange's general index fell 1.00 percent to 2,612.73 in turnover of 4.65 billion crowns.
Ericsson slipped three to 249.5 after releasing first quarter figures.

"This was a strong report and the increase in mobile phone sales was fantastic," an analyst said. "But on the negative side can be noted the negative cash flow and somewhat weaker sales on mobile systems."
Mining and rubber group Trelleborg ended flat at 124.5 after presenting its first quarter report.
Drugs majors Astra and Pharmacia & Upjohn rose in a recovery. Astra gained three to 308 and Pharmacia & Upjohn jumped four to 232.
Bank shares were bashed on surging bond yields and the sector plummeted 2.76 percent.
"I think the focus will be on cyclicals now," a trader said. "Interest-rate sensitive shares have had their strong period."
The cyclical forestry sector edged 0.36 percent lower.
